title: ABC IIIF applicability decision
description: Per-work decision recording whether IIIF Presentation 3.0 applies. ADR 0014. The decision policy itself lives in the ADR; each record carries only the per-work outcome.

status.description: applicable: a derived IIIF Presentation manifest is published. not_applicable: text-only work, no images / facsimiles in scope. rights_blocker: images exist but rights prevent publication.

reason.description: Free-text rationale for the chosen status; required for auditability.

derived_manifest.description: Path or URL of the derived IIIF Presentation 3.0 manifest when status=applicable; null otherwise.
